organizations.nameVariants: Pathé; Pathé disques. The record business of Pathé passed to Columbia Graphophone in 1928 and became Pathé-Marconi in 1936, so the 1934 imprint is not the same body as Pathé Frères, which holds the authority record

sources.shortCitation: Pathé PA362, “Vivons l’amour, vivons la vie” (Guy Berry, 1934)
sources.fullCitation: Guy Berry. “Vivons l’amour, vivons la vie (de la revue du Casino de Paris „Parade de France“).” Music-hall; composers and authors given as Walter Jurmann, Bronisław Kaper, Henri Varna and Marc Cab. Pathé PA362, matrix cpt-1514-1, further inscription “Chatou M3-77510”; 25 cm needle-cut electrical disc, 78 rpm, recorded October 1934. Phonobase, record 15273: transfer made on 4 February 2023 from a copy in the collection of Christian Declerck, Dunkerque. The record page adds that Tino Rossi created the song in 1934, that Mireille, Guy Berry and Priolet took it up, and that the publisher was Coda, Heugel, Paris, 1934. Accessed 16 August 2026.
